Keep the character identity, characteristic colors, head tuft, face-mask arrangement and distinctive beak color from its reference. No clothing or props. Match a consistent character set. Centered full body standing, facing viewer with a slight three-quarter turn; one flipper lifted in a tiny welcoming gesture. Genuine transparent alpha background, no scene, floor, background panel, text, labels, numbers, logos or watermark. Not 3D, photorealistic, furry, textured or sketchy. Do not create a sprite sheet or multiple characters.
POLLY: soft pastel pink body, clean white face and belly, warm golden-yellow beak and feet, three simple pink tuft feathers. Her expression is an open welcoming happy smile. This supplied image is the identity reference, not a required pose or exact body ratio.
